chunks: Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-Bilād narrated from his father, attributing it to the Messenger of Allah (ṣ), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (ṣ) said: "And what will cast people into the Fire except the harvests of their tongues?"
ai.seo_question: What is the main cause of people entering Hellfire according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kitab al-Zuhd*, the Prophet (ṣ) employs the metaphor of 'harvest' (ḥaṣā'id) to illustrate that the tongue's utterances are the accumulated deeds that will be cast into Hellfire, emphasizing the gravity of unguarded speech. This aligns with the Shia scholarly emphasis on *hifz al-lisan* (guarding the tongue) as a critical component of *zuhd* (asceticism) and spiritual purification, where verbal sins are viewed as direct precursors to eternal punishment.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 18.Ibrāhīm ibn Abī al-Bilād narrated from his father who attributed it to the Messenger of Allah (ṣ), that he said, “
And will anything plunge people into the Fire [of Hell] other than what their tongues reap?”[1]
